cycles.statusNote: Original signed one-page scan, form, authority article and news register retained. First connector output awaits founder review. No exact office closing clock time is printed.
cycles.scopeLabel: Mizoram Remote Sensing Application Centre provisional employment. Notice names Aizawl application-delivery office; final work posting and selection venue are not separately stated.
cycles.outcome: 2 Group D Provisional Employee positions; ₹11,529 monthly remuneration plus ₹461 medical allowance (₹11,990 total). Notice does not state tenure or confer permanent-service status.
cycles.qualifications: High School Leaving Certificate (HSLC) from a recognized institution; working knowledge of Mizo language up to middle-school standard, per signed advertisement table. The form asks for proof of passing Mizo as a subject in Class VIII or above. Exact equivalence and documents require review.
cycles.citizenshipRule: Signed advertisement and application form do not state a nationality or foreign-citizen rule. International applicant permission needs MIRSAC Recruitment Rules, 2018 or authority confirmation; permanent-address and identity fields alone cannot establish citizenship restriction.
cycles.residenceRule: No Mizoram domicile or residence condition is printed in the retained advertisement or form. Aizawl is the delivery office, not evidence of applicant domicile.
selectionStages: Obtain official form and submit it with documents and applicable fee to MIRSAC office during office hours
Selection stages and venue are not stated in retained notice; authority review required
Document and Mizo-language proof verification before provisional engagement
cycles.fee: ₹200 general; ₹150 SC/ST/OBC; persons with disabilities exempt. Pay with submitted form, as stated in signed advertisement.
